p3.title: Login screen
ch1.title: Log in
sec1.1.title: Login screen
sec1.2.title: Failed login
sec1.3.title: Account lock
sec1.4.title: Successful login (platform home)
cover.title: Log in
p3s1i0: This is the first screen for accessing the system. When you authenticate with your registered email and password, a session is issued and you go to the platform home. Only accounts that an administrator has registered in advance can be used. You cannot create an account on this screen.
p3s2i0: Email — Enter the email address registered to your account.
p3s2i1: Password — Enter your login password. This is a separate value from your e-signature password.
p3s2i2: Stay logged in — If you select this, your session stays active even after you close and reopen the browser. Do not select this on a shared PC.
p3s2i3: Log in — Requests authentication. On success, you go to the platform home. However, the landing screen varies depending on the login situation 1.4.
p3s2i4: Forgot your password? — Goes to the password reset screen Ch. 2.
p3s2i5: Password visibility toggle — Shows the password you entered in plain text. Do not use it in an environment where other people are nearby.
p3s2i6: Language display — Shows the current display language (Korean). You cannot select it, and a function to switch to another language is not yet available.
p3s3i0: Only one simultaneous session is allowed per account. If you log in with the same account on another device or browser, the session that was already open ends immediately, and any unsaved input is not kept.
p4.title: Failed login
p4s1i0: If the combination of email and password does not match, a warning appears below the input fields and the screen stays as it is. The system does not tell you which one is wrong — both cases show the same message so that it does not reveal whether an account exists.
p4.cap.1: Email or password does not match
p4s2i0: Your entries are kept. You can retry by correcting only the password, without re-entering the email.
p4s2i2: The warning “Email or password does not match. The account locks after 5 failed attempts.” is displayed. The number of remaining attempts is not shown.
p4s2i3: If you cannot remember your password, do not keep retrying. Reset it with Forgot your password? Ch. 2.
p4s3i0: The number of failed attempts keeps accumulating until a login succeeds. Refreshing the screen or reopening the browser does not reset it.
p5.title: Account lock
p5s1i0: The account locks after 5 consecutive failed login attempts. A locked account cannot log in even with the correct password, and it does not unlock automatically after a set period of time. A system administrator must unlock the account.
p5.cap.1: After 5 consecutive failures — the button changes to “Account locked” and is disabled
p5s2i0: The Log in button changes to “Account locked” and cannot be selected. The email and password fields are also disabled.
p5s2i1: The warning “The account has been locked. Contact your system administrator.” is displayed in red.
p5s3i0: A password reset does not lift the lock. Even if you receive a reset link and set a new password, the account stays locked, so ask your system administrator to unlock it.
p6.title: Successful login (platform home)
p6s1i0: When authentication succeeds, you go to the platform home. The screen content varies by permission, and this is where you enter workspaces and projects. However, the platform home is not always the landing screen — see Precautions below. The screenshot shows the screen of a system administrator account.
p6.cap.1: Landing screen after login — platform home (SCR-DASH-000)
p6s2i0: Left menu — Shows only the items that match your permissions. Menus you have no permission for do not appear in the list.
p6s2i1: Resume — The workspace you entered most recently. It takes you there directly, without going through the list.
p6s2i2: Notifications — Shows notifications you have not checked yet.
p6s2i3: Workspace list — Shows the workspaces you have access to. Select one to expand the projects under it.
p6s2i4: Context switcher — Shows the current workspace and project, and lets you switch to another context from any screen.
p6s2i5: Personal data masking — Whether subject identification information is displayed depends on your permissions.
p6s3i0: The landing screen depends on three cases. Normally it is the platform home. If your session expired and you were returned to the login screen, you go back to the screen you were viewing just before. If a password change is required, you go to the password change screen. If the platform home is not displayed, this is not an error.
p6s3i1: If there is no activity for 30 minutes after login, your session expires and you return to the login screen. Even if you keep working, you must log in again 24 hours after your first login.
p7.title: Reset request
ch2.title: Password reset
sec2.1.title: Reset request
sec2.2.title: Check the request email
sec2.3.title: Set a new password
sec2.4.title: Input checks
sec2.5.title: Log in after reset
p7s1i0: If you have lost your password, you receive a reset link at your registered email. Start from Forgot your password? on the login screen (SCR-ACC-005).
p7s2i0: Email — Enter the email address registered to your account.
p7s2i1: The address you entered is displayed. Even if you enter an address that is not registered, the same completion message appears — the response does not differ, so it does not reveal whether an account exists.
p7s2i2: Send reset link — Sends a reset email to the address you entered.
p7s2i3: Back to login screen — Stops the reset and returns to the login screen.
p7s3i0: If the email does not arrive, check your spam folder first. If it is still not there, the address you entered may differ from the one registered to your account.
p8.title: Check the request email
p8s1i0: The email you receive contains a link for setting a new password. This link can be used only once, and it expires after the time stated in the email.
p8s2i0: Password reset — Select to open the Set a new password screen.
p8s2i1: The sender address is for sending only. Replies to this email are not delivered.
p8s2i2: If the button does not work in your environment, paste the address below directly into the browser address bar.
p8s2i3: The validity period is shown. If you open the link after it has expired, the message “The reset link has expired. Please request it again.” appears, so request a new link in 2.1.
p8s3i0: The reason a link cannot be used is shown as one of three messages — if the deadline has passed, “The reset link has expired”; if the address is wrong, “The reset link is not valid”; if the link has already been used to complete a reset, “The reset link has already been used.” In every case, request a new link in 2.1.
p8s3i1: If you receive a reset email you did not request, do not select the link. Notify your system administrator. If you ignore the email, your existing password stays unchanged.
p9.title: Set a new password
p9s1i0: When you open the link in the email, the screen for setting a new password appears. You can complete the reset only when all conditions are met and the values in both input fields match.
p9.cap.1: Right after opening the link — no conditions are met yet, so the button is disabled
p9s2i0: New password — Enter the password you want to use.
p9s2i1: The condition list updates as you type. Each condition you meet changes to a check mark.
p9s2i2: Confirm password — Enter the same value once more.
p9s2i3: Complete reset — Stays disabled until all conditions are met and the two values match.
p9s2i4: The target account is shown with part of it masked. Check that it is the account you intended.
p9s2i5: Password visibility toggle — Shows the entered value in plain text.
p9s3i0: The specific conditions and how many there are may vary depending on system settings. Use the list shown on the screen as your reference.
p10.title: Input check ① Conditions not met · Mismatch
p10s1i0: If a condition is not met or the values in the two fields differ, the system tells you right there. These are two separate checks, so you cannot complete the reset by fixing only one of them.
p10.cap.1: A special character is missing and the two values do not match at the same time
p10s2i0: This applies when you enter a value that does not meet the conditions.
p10s2i1: Only the items that are not met remain with a gray ✕. Check this list to see what is missing.
p10s2i2: This applies when you enter a value in Confirm password that differs from the value in New password.
p10s2i3: The message “Passwords do not match.” appears below the input field.
p10s2i4: If either check fails, Complete reset stays disabled.
p10s3i0: The condition list checks only the New password field. Even if every item in the list shows as met, you cannot complete the reset if the two values differ.
p11.title: Input check ② Conditions met
p11s1i0: When all conditions are met and the two fields match, you can complete the reset.
p11.cap.1: All conditions met and the two values match — the button is enabled
p11s2i0: This applies when you enter a value that meets all the conditions.
p11s2i1: Every item in the list changes to a green check mark.
p11s2i2: Enter the same value in Confirm password. The mismatch message disappears.
p11s2i3: Complete reset is enabled. Select it to change your password and go to the login screen.
p11s3i0: The link expires immediately once you complete the reset. You cannot use the same link to open the page and change your password again, so make sure you remember your new password before you complete the reset.
p12.title: Log in after reset
p12s1i0: When the reset is finished, you return to the login screen. You are not logged in automatically, so you must authenticate again with your new password.
p12.cap.1: Login screen returned to after completing the reset
p12s2i0: Log in — Authenticate with your new password. On success, you go to the platform home 1.4.
p12s2i1: The completion message “Your password has been reset. Please log in with your new password.” is displayed.
p12s2i2: The email field appears filled in because of your browser's autofill. The system does not fill it in, so it is blank in another browser or in a private browsing window.
p12s2i3: The password field is empty. Enter the newly set password.
p12s3i0: Resetting your password does not clear the existing failed-attempt count or the account lock. A locked account must be unlocked by a system administrator 1.3.
p13.title: Open the profile menu
ch3.title: Log out
sec3.1.title: Open the profile menu
sec3.2.title: Confirm logout
p13s1i0: You log out from the profile menu at the top right of the screen. This menu also groups your account-related settings.
p13.cap.1: Profile icon at the top right (①) selected — the red number on the notification icon is the count of unread notifications, not a marker
p13s2i0: Profile icon — Select to expand the account menu. It is in the same place on every screen.
p13s2i1: The name and email of the account you are currently logged in with are displayed. You can check that it is the account you intended.
p13s2i2: Log out — Opens a confirmation window 3.2.
p13s2i3: Change password — Use this when you know your current password and want to change it. The badge next to it shows the time remaining until the password expires.
p13s2i4: Set e-signature password — This is a separate value from your login password.
p13s3i0: Passwords expire every 90 days. Even after expiry, your work is not blocked right away — in the notice dialog you can postpone the change up to 3 times. Only after you have used all the postponements are you taken to the change screen at your next login, and you cannot proceed with your work until you change the password. If the badge shows the remaining time, change your password in advance.
p14.title: Confirm logout
p14s1i0: When you select Log out, a confirmation window opens. Confirming ends your session and returns you to the login screen.
p14s2i0: Log out — Ends your session. You cannot return to the previous screen with the browser's back button.
p14s2i1: Cancel — Stops the logout and returns you to the screen you were on.
p14s2i2: The confirmation message “Do you want to log out?” is displayed.
p14s3i0: Input you were in the middle of entering is not kept unless you save it. Finish saving before you log out.
